def _eligible_responsible(self, doc, user):
        access = self.env['ydental.access.service']
        member = access._membership(user.id, doc.ydental_store_id.id)
        snapshot = doc.ydental_current_execution_id.ydental_service_snapshot
        return bool(user.active and doc.ydental_store_id.company_id in user.company_ids and member and
            member.ydental_employee_id.active and access._levels(member)['medical'] == 'write' and

clinical._valid_editor.source:
def _valid_editor(self, doc):
        queue = self._queue()
        if not doc.ydental_editor_id or not doc.ydental_editor_expires or doc.ydental_editor_expires <= queue._now():
            return False
        session = doc.ydental_session_id
        if not session or session.ydental_revision != doc.ydental_session_revision or session.ydental_store_id != doc.ydental_store_id or not self._eligible_responsible(doc, doc.ydental_editor_id):
            return False
        lease = doc.ydental_editor_lease_id
        if lease and (not lease.ydental_active or lease.ydental_expires_at <= queue._now() or
                      lease.ydental_revision != session.ydental_revision or lease.ydental_session_id != session or
                      self._queue()._service_eligibility(self._queue()._execution_entry(doc.ydental_current_execution_id),
                          lease.ydental_station_id, doc.ydental_editor_id)):
            return False
        return True

exam._correct.source:
def _correct(self, line_id, version, findings, measurements, conclusion, reason):
        line = self._line(line_id, write=True)
        result = self._result(line)
        if not result or result.state != 'confirmed':
            raise UserError(self.env._('result_required: Correct only a confirmed result.'))
        self._editor(result, version)
        reason = self.env['ydental.intake.service']._text(reason)
        if not isinstance(measurements, dict):
            raise ValidationError(self.env._('invalid_result: Measurement updates must be a field map.'))
        findings, measurements, conclusion = self._content(findings,
            dict(result.ydental_measurements or {}) | measurements, conclusion, result.ydental_template_code)
        if not findings:
            raise ValidationError(self.env._('result_required: Confirmed findings cannot be blank.'))
        result._save({'ydental_findings': findings, 'ydental_measurements': measurements,
            'ydental_conclusion': conclusion, 'ydental_version': version + 1})
        self._version(result, 'correction', reason)
        return {'result_id': result.id, 'version': result.ydental_version, 'state': result.state}

exam._editor.source:
def _editor(self, result, version):
        session, connection = self.env['ydental.queue.service']._connection()
        if result.ydental_responsible_id.id != self.env.uid:
            raise AccessError(self.env._('responsibility_required: Take over this result with an explicit reason before editing.'))
        if type(version) is not int or result.ydental_version != version:
            raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: Refresh the examination result before editing.'))
        if result.ydental_current_editor_id and result.ydental_edit_until > fields.Datetime.now() and (
                result.ydental_current_editor_id.id != self.env.uid or result.ydental_edit_session_id != session or
                result.ydental_edit_revision != session.ydental_revision or
                not consteq(result.ydental_edit_connection_hash, connection.key_hash)):
            raise AccessError(self.env._('editor_busy: This result is held by another live editor.'))
        result._save({'ydental_current_editor_id': self.env.uid, 'ydental_edit_session_id': session.id,
            'ydental_edit_revision': session.ydental_revision, 'ydental_edit_connection_hash': connection.key_hash,
            'ydental_edit_until': fields.Datetime.now() + timedelta(minutes=5)})

def _line(self, line_id, write=False):
        store = self._store(write)
        line = self.env['ydental.treatment.line'].sudo().browse(self.env['ydental.intake.service']._id(line_id)).exists()
        if not line or line.ydental_order_id.ydental_kind != 'exam' or line.ydental_store_id != store or (
                line.ydental_order_id.ydental_patient_id != line.ydental_patient_id or
                line.ydental_task_id.ydental_mapping_id != line.ydental_mapping_id):
            raise AccessError(self.env._('source_required: Select a real frozen examination line in this store.'))
        self.env['ydental.patient.service']._current_relation(line.ydental_patient_id, store)
        return line

exam._perform.source:
def _perform(self, line_id, execution_id, lease_id, lease_token, inline, reason, materials, actual_at=None):
        line = self._line(line_id, write=True)
        execution = self._actual(line, execution_id, lease_id, lease_token, inline)
        if line.state not in ('issued', 'started') or self._model('result').search([('ydental_line_id', '=', line.id), ('ydental_event_id', '!=', False)], limit=1):
            raise UserError(self.env._('already_started: This line already has an actual execution fact.'))
        result = self._result(line, create=True, execution=execution)
        if result.state not in ('draft', 'started'):
            raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: This result cannot be performed again.'))
        catalog = line.ydental_mapping_id.ydental_catalog_id
        event = self.env['ydental.treatment.service']._event(execution, catalog, line.ydental_quantity,
            's09-exam-line-' + str(line.id), reason, materials, already_performed=True,
            kind='exam', line=line, actual_at=actual_at)
        result._save({'ydental_execution_id': execution.id, 'ydental_event_id': event['event_id'],
            'ydental_started_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'ydental_business_date': self.env['ydental.supply.service']._date(line.ydental_store_id),
            'ydental_station_id': execution.ydental_lease_id.ydental_station_id.id, 'state': 'pending'})
        line._save({'state': 'done'})
        response = dict(event, result_id=result.id, line_id=line.id,
            event_state=event['state'], result_document_state=result.state,
            order_line_state=line.state, fee_source_state='recorded' if event['fee_id'] else 'absent')
        self._audit('actual_performed', result, response, reason)
        return response

exam._version.source:
def _version(self, result, kind, reason=''):
        previous = self._model('version').search([('ydental_result_id', '=', result.id)], order='ydental_number desc', limit=1)
        version = self._model('version')._new({'name': result.name, 'ydental_store_id': result.ydental_store_id.id,
            'ydental_category': 'exam', 'ydental_patient_id': result.ydental_patient_id.id, 'ydental_actor_id': self.env.uid,
            'ydental_result_id': result.id, 'ydental_number': result.ydental_version,
            'ydental_kind': kind, 'ydental_findings': result.ydental_findings,
            'ydental_measurements': result.ydental_measurements, 'ydental_conclusion': result.ydental_conclusion,
            'ydental_reason': reason, 'ydental_recorded_at': fields.Datetime.now(),
            'ydental_previous_id': previous.id if previous else False})
        self._audit(kind, version, {'result_id': result.id, 'version': result.ydental_version}, reason)
        return version

inventory._event.source:
def _event(self, store, namespace, source_key, kind, lot, quantity, uom_id, source, target, reason,
               parent=None, target_store=None, summary='', snapshot=None, actual_at=None, synthetic=False,
               responsible=None, fee_reference='', actual=False):
        source_key = self._text(source_key)
        namespace = self._text(namespace)
        quantity_stock, unit, unit_snapshot = self._unit(lot.product_id, quantity, uom_id)
        reason = self._text(reason)
        digest = fingerprint([kind, lot.id, quantity, unit.id, source.id, target.id, reason,
            parent.id if parent else False, summary, snapshot, fee_reference, synthetic])
        prior = self._model('event').search([('ydental_store_id', '=', store.id), ('ydental_source_namespace', '=', namespace),
            ('ydental_source_key', '=', self._text(source_key))], limit=1)
        if prior:
            if prior.ydental_fingerprint != digest:
                raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: The source event is immutable.'))
            return prior
        unusable = False
        if kind in ('replenishment', 'treatment', 'chairside', 'prescription', 'transfer'):
            try:
                self._usable(lot, store)
            except UserError:
                if not actual: raise
                unusable = True
        event = self._model('event')._new({'name': kind, 'ydental_store_id': store.id,
            'ydental_source_namespace': namespace, 'ydental_source_key': source_key, 'ydental_kind': kind,
            'ydental_fingerprint': digest, 'ydental_product_id': lot.product_id.id, 'ydental_lot_id': lot.id,
            'ydental_quantity': quantity_stock, 'ydental_input_quantity': quantity, 'ydental_uom_id': unit.id,
            'ydental_unit_snapshot': unit_snapshot, 'ydental_from_id': source.id, 'ydental_to_id': target.id,
            'ydental_parent_id': parent.id if parent else False, 'ydental_target_store_id': target_store.id if target_store else False,
            'ydental_responsible_id': responsible.id if responsible else self.env.uid, 'ydental_actor_id': self.env.uid,
            'ydental_reason': reason, 'ydental_summary': summary, 'ydental_price_snapshot': snapshot,
            'ydental_actual_at': actual_at or self._now(), 'ydental_synthetic': synthetic, 'ydental_fee_reference': fee_reference,
            'state': 'pending' if actual else 'done'})
        # An already-performed trusted source can persist as pending, with no
        # half move. All other shortages fail the enclosing savepoint.
        if unusable or source.usage == 'internal' and lot.product_id.uom_id.compare(self._quantity(lot, source), quantity_stock) < 0:
            if not actual:
                raise UserError(self.env._('insufficient_balance: There is insufficient available stock.'))
            self._audit('pending', event, after={'event_id': event.id, 'responsible_id': event.ydental_responsible_id.id})
            return event
        self._move(event)
        return event

inventory._lock.source:
def _lock(self):
        # Single inventory fence closes absent-quant/source races. The UPDATE
        # also forces repeatable-read contenders to retry from a fresh snapshot.
        self.env.cr.execute('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(%s)', [31007])
        self.env.cr.execute('UPDATE ydental_inventory_mutex SET ydental_revision=ydental_revision+1 WHERE id=%s',
            [self.env.ref('ydental_inventory.ydental_inventory_mutex').id])
        self.env.invalidate_all()

inventory._move.source:
def _move(self, event):
        if event.ydental_move_id:
            return
        lot = event.ydental_lot_id
        source, target = event.ydental_from_id, event.ydental_to_id
        if source.usage == 'internal' and lot.product_id.uom_id.compare(self._quantity(lot, source), event.ydental_quantity) < 0:
            raise UserError(self.env._('insufficient_balance: There is insufficient available stock.'))
        move = self._native('stock.move').with_company(event.ydental_store_id.company_id).create({
            'product_id': lot.product_id.id, 'product_uom_qty': event.ydental_quantity, 'uom_id': lot.product_id.uom_id.id,
            'location_id': source.id, 'location_dest_id': target.id, 'company_id': event.ydental_store_id.company_id.id,
            'ydental_store_id': event.ydental_store_id.id, 'origin': 'YDental inventory event %s' % event.id,
            'is_inventory': event.ydental_kind == 'inventory'})
        move._action_confirm(merge=False, create_proc=False)
        move._do_unreserve()
        self._native('stock.move.line').with_company(event.ydental_store_id.company_id).create({'move_id': move.id,
            'product_id': lot.product_id.id, 'uom_id': lot.product_id.uom_id.id, 'quantity': event.ydental_quantity,
            'lot_id': lot.id, 'location_id': source.id, 'location_dest_id': target.id,
            'company_id': event.ydental_store_id.company_id.id, 'ydental_store_id': event.ydental_store_id.id, 'picked': True})
        move.write({'picked': True})
        move._action_done()
        if move.state != 'done':
            raise UserError(self.env._('inventory_error: Native movement did not finish.'))
        if event.ydental_target_store_id:
            self._target_lot(lot, event.ydental_target_store_id)
        event._save({'ydental_move_id': move.id, 'state': 'done'})
        if event.ydental_kind == 'receipt':
            batch = self._batch(lot, event.ydental_store_id)
            if not batch.ydental_received_at:
                batch._save({'ydental_received_at': self._now()})
        self._audit('movement', event, after={'event_id': event.id, 'move_id': move.id, 'quantity': event.ydental_quantity})

inventory._operate.source:
def _operate(self, operation, payload, key):
        handlers = {'setup': self._setup, 'policy': self._policy, 'product': self._create_product,
            'product_edit': self._edit_product, 'lot': self._create_lot, 'lot_edit': self._edit_lot,
            'receive': self._receive, 'issue': self._issue, 'inventory': self._inventory,
            'transfer': self._transfer, 'return': self._return, 'verify': self._verify, 'recover': self._recover}
        if operation not in handlers or not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: Unknown inventory action.'))
        key = self._text(key)
        catalog = operation in ('product', 'product_edit')
        store = self._access(write=True, catalog=catalog)
        digest = fingerprint([operation, store.id, payload])
        with self.env.cr.savepoint():
            self._lock()
            store = self._access(write=True, catalog=catalog)
            receipt = self._model('operation').search([('ydental_store_id', '=', store.id), ('ydental_key', '=', key)], limit=1)
            if receipt:
                if receipt.ydental_fingerprint != digest:
                    raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: The request key has different inventory arguments.'))
                return dict(receipt.ydental_result, result='already_accepted')
            try:
                inspect.signature(handlers[operation]).bind(store, **payload)
            except TypeError as error:
                raise ValidationError(self.env._('Unknown or missing inventory arguments.')) from error
            result = dict(handlers[operation](store, **payload), result='accepted')
            receipt = self._model('operation')._new({'name': operation, 'ydental_store_id': store.id,
                'ydental_key': key, 'ydental_fingerprint': digest, 'ydental_result': result, 'ydental_actor_id': self.env.uid})
            self._audit(operation, receipt, after=result)
            return result

inventory._source_action.source:
def _source_action(self, source):
        payload = self._authorize_source(source)
        with self.env.cr.savepoint():
            self._lock()
            payload = self._authorize_source(source)
            access = self.env['ydental.access.service']
            store = access._scope(write=True).ydental_store_id
            kind = payload['kind']
            if kind not in ('treatment', 'chairside', 'prescription'):
                raise ValidationError(self.env._('Select a supported execution source kind.'))
            access._check('pharmacy' if kind == 'prescription' else 'medical', 'write', write=True)
            lot = self._lot(payload['lot_id'], store); config = self._config(store)
            self._check_source_product(kind, lot)
            snapshot = payload['price_snapshot']
            if not isinstance(snapshot, dict) or not snapshot.get('version') or not snapshot.get('currency') or 'unit_price' not in snapshot:
                raise ValidationError(self.env._('A frozen original source price snapshot is required.'))
            event = self._event(store, payload['namespace'], payload['source_key'], kind, lot,
                payload['quantity'], payload['uom_id'], self._location(config, lot.product_id), config.ydental_customer_id,
                payload['reason'], summary=payload['summary'], snapshot=snapshot, synthetic=payload['synthetic'],
                responsible=self.env.user, fee_reference=payload['fee_reference'], actual=payload['already_performed'])
            return {'id': event.id, 'state': event.state, 'move_id': event.ydental_move_id.id}

def _lock(self):
        # Advisory locking alone does not refresh a repeatable-read snapshot.
        # Updating this fence forces a stale competing transaction to retry.
        self.env.cr.execute('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(%s)', [28004])
        mutex = self.env.ref('ydental_patient.ydental_patient_mutex')
        self.env.cr.execute('UPDATE ydental_patient_mutex SET ydental_revision=ydental_revision+1 WHERE id=%s', [mutex.id])

print._authorize.source:
def _authorize(self, kind, source_id, version, purpose=None):
        if kind not in TEMPLATES or type(version) is not int or version < 0 or purpose not in (None, '', 'diagnosis', 'history_review'):
            raise ValidationError(self.env._('invalid_source: Select a documented PDF type, source and version.'))
        access = self.env['ydental.access.service']
        session = access._scope()
        store = session.ydental_store_id
        access._check('export', 'write')
        if store.company_id not in self.env.user.sudo().company_ids:
            raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: The current company is unavailable.'))
        if kind in ('clinical', 'consent'):
            clinical = self.env['ydental.clinical.service']
            preliminary = self.env['ydental.clinical.document'].sudo().browse(self._id(source_id)).exists()
            if not preliminary:
                raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: This PDF source is unavailable.'))
            if purpose:
                clinical = access._patient_care(preliminary.ydental_patient_id.id, purpose).env['ydental.clinical.service']
            doc = clinical._document(source_id)
            versions = clinical._model('version')
            selected = versions.search([('ydental_document_id', '=', doc.id), ('ydental_number', '=', version)], limit=1)
            if (not selected and version != 0) or version == 0 and doc.ydental_version != 0:
                raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: The selected clinical version is unavailable.'))
            if selected:
                clinical.env['ydental.clinical.version'].browse(selected.id).check_access('read')
            return clinical.env[self._name], doc, selected, 'medical'
        treatment = self.env['ydental.treatment.service']
        order = self.env['ydental.treatment.order'].sudo().browse(self._id(source_id)).exists()
        if not order or order.ydental_kind != 'prescription' or order.ydental_store_id != store or purpose:
            raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: This prescription is unavailable in the current store.'))
        member = access._membership(self.env.uid, store.id)
        levels = access._levels(member)
        if levels['medical'] in ('read', 'write'):
            treatment._access('medical', False)
            self.env['ydental.treatment.order'].browse(order.id).check_access('read')
            category = 'medical'
        else:
            treatment._access('pharmacy', False)
            # Narrow trusted projection only: an issued prescription with a real
            # local pharmacy task, never clinical content or draft orders.
            segments = self.env['ydental.treatment.segment'].sudo().search([
                ('ydental_order_id', '=', order.id), ('ydental_store_id', '=', store.id)])
            if order.state not in ('issued', 'done') or not segments or any(
                s.ydental_task_id.ydental_patient_id != order.ydental_patient_id or
                s.ydental_task_id.ydental_store_id != store or s.ydental_task_id.ydental_mapping_id.ydental_execution_area_id.ydental_purpose != 'pharmacy'
                for s in segments
            ):
                raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: A real current prescription pharmacy task is required.'))
            category = 'pharmacy'
        self.env['ydental.patient.service']._current_relation(order.ydental_patient_id, store)
        if order.ydental_version != version:
            raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: Refresh the prescription version.'))
        return self, order, False, category

print._job.source:
def _job(self, job_id):
        session = self.env['ydental.access.service']._scope()
        # Narrow sudo is necessary because no ordinary ACL exposes job bodies.
        job = self.env['ydental.print.job'].sudo().browse(self._id(job_id)).exists()
        if not job or (job.ydental_actor_id.id, job.ydental_session_id.id, job.ydental_revision, job.ydental_store_id.id) != (
            self.env.uid, session.id, session.ydental_revision, session.ydental_store_id.id) or job.ydental_expires_at <= fields.Datetime.now():
            raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: This temporary PDF is unavailable. Generate a new demonstration copy.'))
        service, source, category, payload, signature = self._source(job.ydental_kind, job.ydental_source_id, job.ydental_version, job.ydental_purpose or None)
        if signature != job.ydental_source_digest:
            raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: The source changed. Review and generate a new demonstration copy.'))
        return job, source, category, payload, signature

print._operate.source:
def _operate(self, operation, payload):
        # Public RPC cannot create RenderScope or S01 Binding instances. This
        # private service is reached only through the server HTTP adapter.
        handlers = {'preview': self._preview, 'generate': self._generate,
                    'pdf_view': lambda job_id: self._deliver('pdf_view', job_id),
                    'download': lambda job_id: self._deliver('download', job_id),
                    'print_request': lambda job_id: self._deliver('print_request', job_id)}
        if operation not in handlers or not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ValidationError(self.env._('invalid_action: Select a documented PDF operation.'))
        try:
            inspect.signature(handlers[operation]).bind(**payload)
        except TypeError as error:
            raise ValidationError(self.env._('invalid_source: Unknown or missing PDF arguments.')) from error
        access = self.env['ydental.access.service']
        access._lock_user(self.env.uid)
        session = access._scope(write=True)
        # Under PostgreSQL repeatable read, advisory/row locks alone do not
        # refresh a waiting request's snapshot. A value-preserving session
        # fence makes a competing PDF action retry in a fresh transaction.
        self.env.cr.execute('UPDATE ydental_access_session SET ydental_revision=ydental_revision WHERE id=%s', [session.id])
        # Detect a grant/lifecycle change committed while this request waited
        # on the S01 actor lock; do not accept stale positive permission data.
        self.env.cr.execute('SELECT id FROM res_users WHERE id=%s FOR NO KEY UPDATE', [self.env.uid])
        self.env.cr.execute('SELECT id FROM ydental_access_membership WHERE ydental_user_id=%s AND ydental_store_id=%s FOR NO KEY UPDATE', [self.env.uid, session.ydental_store_id.id])
        members = [row[0] for row in self.env.cr.fetchall()]
        self.env.cr.execute('SELECT id FROM ydental_access_grant WHERE ydental_membership_id=ANY(%s) FOR NO KEY UPDATE', [members])
        with self.env.cr.savepoint():
            return handlers[operation](**payload)

queue._connection.source:
def _connection(self):
        session = self.env['ydental.access.service']._scope(write=True)
        connection = self.env.context.get('ydental_queue_connection')
        if type(connection) is not Connection or (connection.actor_id, connection.session_id, connection.revision) != (
                self.env.uid, session.id, session.ydental_revision):
            raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: A holding browser connection is required.'))
        return session, connection

settlement._access.source:
def _access(self, write=False, finance=False):
        access = self.env['ydental.access.service']
        category = 'finance_approval' if finance else 'settlement'
        store = access._check(category, 'write' if write else 'read', write=write).ydental_store_id
        if store.company_id not in self.env.user.sudo().company_ids:
            raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: The store company is outside the account scope.'))
        return store

settlement._bill_correction.source:
def _bill_correction(self, fee, store, config):
        parent = fee.ydental_parent_id
        link = self._model('source').search([('ydental_fee_id', '=', parent.id)], limit=1) if parent else False
        if not link or link.ydental_store_id != store or link.ydental_invoice_id.move_type != 'out_invoice':
            raise UserError(self.env._('correction_source_missing: Bill the original confirmed fee first.'))
        original = link.ydental_invoice_id
        currency = store.company_id.currency_id
        amount = currency.round(-fee.ydental_amount)
        if amount <= 0 or currency.compare_amounts(amount, link.ydental_original_amount) > 0:
            raise UserError(self.env._('correction_amount_invalid: Reversal exceeds original source.'))
        date = fee.ydental_event_id.ydental_business_date
        credit = self.env['account.move'].sudo().with_company(store.company_id).create({
            'move_type': 'out_refund', 'company_id': store.company_id.id,
            'journal_id': config.ydental_sales_journal_id.id,
            'partner_id': original.partner_id.id,
            'invoice_date': date, 'date': date, 'currency_id': currency.id,
            'invoice_origin': original.name,
            'invoice_line_ids': [Command.create({
                'name': fee.name, 'quantity': abs(fee.ydental_quantity) or 1,
                'price_unit': fee.ydental_unit_price if fee.ydental_quantity else amount,
                'account_id': config.ydental_income_account_id.id,
                'tax_ids': [Command.clear()],
                'product_id': fee.ydental_product_id.id or False,
            })],
        })
        credit.action_post()
        if credit.state != 'posted' or currency.compare_amounts(credit.amount_total, amount):
            raise UserError(self.env._('accounting_mismatch: Native correction credit differs from fee.'))
        line = credit.invoice_line_ids[:1]
        snapshot = fee.ydental_price_snapshot_id
        self._model('source')._new({
            'ydental_fee_id': fee.id, 'ydental_store_id': store.id,
            'ydental_patient_id': fee.ydental_patient_id.id,
            'ydental_invoice_id': credit.id, 'ydental_line_id': line.id,
            'ydental_original_amount': fee.ydental_amount,
            'ydental_currency_id': currency.id,
            'ydental_source_business_date': date,
            'ydental_source_actual_at': fee.ydental_event_id.ydental_actual_at,
            'ydental_price_version': 'S05:' + str(snapshot.ydental_price_id.id)
                if snapshot else 'review:' + str(fee.ydental_price_review_id.id),
        })
        allocated = min(original.amount_residual, amount)
        if allocated > 0:
            self.env['account.partial.reconcile'].sudo().with_company(store.company_id).create({
                'debit_move_id': self._receivable(original, debit=True).id,
                'credit_move_id': self._receivable(credit, debit=False).id,
                'amount': allocated, 'debit_amount_currency': allocated,
                'credit_amount_currency': allocated,
            })
        self._audit('bill_correction', credit, store, after={'fee_id': fee.id,
            'original_invoice_id': original.id, 'credit_amount': amount,
            'unpaid_reduced': allocated})
        return {'credit_note_id': credit.id, 'amount': -amount,
                'unpaid_reduced': allocated, 'actually_refunded': 0}

settlement._invoice.source:
def _invoice(self, invoice_id, store):
        invoice = self.env['account.move'].sudo().browse(self._positive_id(invoice_id)).exists()
        sources = self._model('source').search([('ydental_invoice_id', '=', invoice.id)]) if invoice else False
        if not invoice or invoice.state != 'posted' or invoice.move_type != 'out_invoice' or not sources or (
                any(source.ydental_store_id != store for source in sources)
                or invoice.company_id != store.company_id):
            raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: Select a posted invoice from this store.'))
        return invoice, sources

settlement._pdf.source:
def _pdf(self, kind, source_id):
        target, payload = self._report_payload(kind, source_id)
        session = self.env['ydental.access.service']._scope()
        scope = SettlementPdfScope(self.env.uid, session.id, session.ydental_revision,
            kind, source_id, hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True,
                                                       ensure_ascii=True).encode()).hexdigest())
        report = self.env['ir.actions.report'].with_context(
            ydental_settlement_pdf_scope=scope, lang='zh_CN', force_report_rendering=True,
            report_pdf_no_attachment=True)
        try:
            pdf, result = report._render_qweb_pdf('ydental_settlement.ydental_settlement_pdf', [source_id])
            if result != 'pdf' or not isinstance(pdf, bytes) or not pdf.startswith(b'%PDF-') or len(pdf) > 10000000 or (
                    len(PdfFileReader(io.BytesIO(pdf)).pages) > 20):
                raise UserError(self.env._('render_failed: Settlement PDF is invalid or too long.'))
        except (QWebError, PdfReadError, OSError, ValueError) as error:
            raise UserError(self.env._('render_failed: Settlement PDF could not be generated.')) from error
        digest = hashlib.sha256(pdf).hexdigest()
        self._audit('report_download', target, self._access(), after={'kind': kind, 'pdf_sha256': digest})
        return pdf, digest

settlement._refund_execute.source:
def _refund_execute(self, refund_id, actual_utc, proof):
        store = self._access(write=True)
        config = self._config(store)
        refund = self._refund(refund_id, store)
        if refund.ydental_state != 'approved' or not refund.ydental_approver_id or refund.ydental_requester_id == refund.ydental_approver_id:
            raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: Confirm a distinct approval before actual refund.'))
        payment = refund.ydental_payment_id
        actual = self._instant(actual_utc)
        business_date = self._local_date(store, actual)
        if refund.ydental_requested_at and actual.replace(tzinfo=None) < refund.ydental_requested_at:
            raise UserError(self.env._('refund_time_invalid: Actual refund cannot precede its application.'))
        refund_channel = self._effective_channel(payment)
        correction = self._model('correction').search([
            ('ydental_payment_id', '=', payment.id)], order='id desc', limit=1)
        if correction and actual.replace(tzinfo=None) < correction.ydental_recorded_at:
            raise UserError(self.env._('refund_channel_review_required: Refund time precedes the channel correction.'))
        self._close_guard(store, self.env.uid, business_date, refund_channel)
        currency = payment.ydental_currency_id
        journal = self._journal(config, refund_channel)
        method = journal.outbound_payment_method_line_ids.filtered(lambda line: line.payment_method_id.code == 'manual')[:1]
        if not method:
            raise UserError(self.env._('accounting_policy_invalid: Native outbound manual method is absent.'))
        original = payment.ydental_payment_id
        partials = self.env['account.partial.reconcile'].sudo().search([
            ('credit_move_id', 'in', original.move_id.line_ids.ids),
            ('debit_move_id.move_id', 'in', payment.ydental_invoice_ids.ids),
        ], order='id')
        if currency.compare_amounts(sum(partials.mapped('amount')), refund.ydental_amount) < 0:
            raise UserError(self.env._('refund_exceeds_allocated: Native receipt allocations are insufficient.'))
        remaining = refund.ydental_amount
        credits = self.env['account.move'].sudo()
        for partial in partials.sorted(key=lambda part: (part.debit_move_id.move_id.invoice_date,
                                                         part.debit_move_id.move_id.id, part.id)):
            if currency.is_zero(remaining):
                break
            amount = min(remaining, partial.amount)
            invoice = partial.debit_move_id.move_id
            credit_note = self.env['account.move'].sudo().with_company(store.company_id).create({
                'move_type': 'out_refund', 'company_id': store.company_id.id,
                'journal_id': config.ydental_sales_journal_id.id,
                'partner_id': invoice.partner_id.id,
                'invoice_date': business_date, 'date': business_date,
                'currency_id': currency.id,
                'invoice_origin': invoice.name,
                'invoice_line_ids': [Command.create({
                    'name': self.env._('Actual offline refund of invoice %s', invoice.name),
                    'quantity': 1, 'price_unit': amount,
                    'account_id': config.ydental_income_account_id.id,
                    'tax_ids': [Command.clear()],
                })],
            })
            credit_note.action_post()
            if credit_note.state != 'posted' or currency.compare_amounts(credit_note.amount_total, amount):
                raise UserError(self.env._('accounting_mismatch: Native credit note did not post correctly.'))
            credits |= credit_note
            remaining = currency.round(remaining - amount)
        if not currency.is_zero(remaining):
            raise UserError(self.env._('accounting_mismatch: Refund credit notes are incomplete.'))
        outbound = self.env['account.payment'].sudo().with_company(store.company_id).create({
            'payment_type': 'outbound', 'partner_type': 'customer',
            'company_id': store.company_id.id, 'partner_id': original.partner_id.id,
            'journal_id': journal.id, 'payment_method_line_id': method.id,
            'amount': refund.ydental_amount, 'currency_id': currency.id, 'date': business_date,
            'memo': self.env._('YDental actually refunded offline'),
            'payment_reference': self._text(proof, 200),
        })
        outbound.action_post()
        if outbound.move_id.state != 'posted':
            raise UserError(self.env._('accounting_mismatch: Native refund payment did not post.'))
        debit = self._receivable(outbound.move_id, debit=True)
        for credit_note in credits:
            credit = self._receivable(credit_note, debit=False)
            amount = credit_note.amount_total
            self.env['account.partial.reconcile'].sudo().with_company(store.company_id).create({
                'debit_move_id': debit.id, 'credit_move_id': credit.id,
                'amount': amount, 'debit_amount_currency': amount, 'credit_amount_currency': amount,
            })
        refund._save({'ydental_state': 'done', 'ydental_executor_id': self.env.uid,
                      'ydental_native_payment_id': outbound.id,
                      'ydental_credit_note_id': credits[:1].id,
                      'ydental_credit_note_ids': [Command.set(credits.ids)],
                      'ydental_actual_at': actual.replace(tzinfo=None),
                      'ydental_refund_business_date': business_date,
                      'ydental_refund_channel': refund_channel,
                      'ydental_terminal_at': actual.replace(tzinfo=None)})
        self._audit('refund.execute', refund, store, after={'native_payment_id': outbound.id,
            'credit_note_ids': credits.ids, 'amount': refund.ydental_amount,
            'business_date': str(business_date), 'channel': refund_channel,
            'executor_id': self.env.uid})
        return {'refund_id': refund.id, 'state': 'done', 'actually_refunded': refund.ydental_amount,
                'native_payment_id': outbound.id, 'credit_note_ids': credits.ids}

settlement._report_payload.source:
def _report_payload(self, kind, source_id):
        store = self._access()
        self.env['ydental.access.service']._check('export', 'write')
        source_id = self._positive_id(source_id)
        currency = store.company_id.currency_id
        payload = {'kind': kind, 'source_id': source_id, 'company': store.company_id.name,
                   'store': store.name, 'currency': currency.name,
                   'operator': self.env.user.name,
                   'demo': '演示线下业务凭据；非税务发票、非银行或支付平台到账证明'}
        if kind == 'bill':
            invoice, sources = self._invoice(source_id, store)
            patient = self._patient(sources[0].ydental_patient_id.id)
            received_partials = self.env['account.partial.reconcile'].sudo().search([
                ('debit_move_id.move_id', '=', invoice.id),
                ('credit_move_id.move_id.origin_payment_id', '!=', False),
            ])
            payload.update({'patient': patient.ydental_number, 'number': invoice.name,
                'business_date': str(invoice.invoice_date), 'total': invoice.amount_total,
                'residual': invoice.amount_residual,
                'received': currency.round(sum(received_partials.mapped('amount'))),
                'lines': [{'name': link.ydental_fee_id.name,
                           'fee_id': link.ydental_fee_id.id, 'amount': link.ydental_original_amount,
                           'price_version': link.ydental_price_version} for link in sources],
                'discount': currency.round(sum(sources.mapped('ydental_discount')))})
            target = invoice
        elif kind == 'receipt':
            payment = self._payment_record(source_id, store)
            patient = self._patient(payment.ydental_patient_id.id)
            partials = self.env['account.partial.reconcile'].sudo().search([
                ('credit_move_id', 'in', payment.ydental_payment_id.move_id.line_ids.ids),
                ('debit_move_id.move_id', 'in', payment.ydental_invoice_ids.ids),
            ], order='id')
            refunds = self._model('refund').search([('ydental_payment_id', '=', payment.id)])
            done = sum(refunds.filtered(lambda row: row.ydental_state == 'done').mapped('ydental_amount'))
            pending = sum(refunds.filtered(lambda row: row.ydental_state in
                ('requested', 'approved', 'failed', 'unknown')).mapped('ydental_amount'))
            payload.update({'patient': patient.ydental_number,
                'number': payment.ydental_payment_id.name,
                'business_date': str(payment.ydental_business_date),
                'actual_utc': str(payment.ydental_actual_at),
                'recorded_utc': str(payment.ydental_entered_at),
                'channel': self._effective_channel(payment),
                'received': payment.ydental_amount, 'refunded': currency.round(done),
                'pending': currency.round(pending),
                'net': currency.round(payment.ydental_amount - done),
                'residual': currency.round(sum(payment.ydental_invoice_ids.mapped('amount_residual'))),
                'allocations': [{'invoice': part.debit_move_id.move_id.name, 'amount': part.amount}
                                for part in partials]})
            target = payment
        elif kind == 'refund':
            refund = self._refund(source_id, store)
            payment = refund.ydental_payment_id
            patient = self._patient(payment.ydental_patient_id.id)
            payload.update({'patient': patient.ydental_number,
                'number': str(refund.id), 'business_date': str(payment.ydental_business_date),
                'state': refund.ydental_state, 'requested': refund.ydental_amount,
                'pending': refund.ydental_amount if refund.ydental_state in
                    ('requested', 'approved', 'failed', 'unknown') else 0,
                'refunded': refund.ydental_amount if refund.ydental_state == 'done' else 0,
                'actual_utc': str(refund.ydental_actual_at or ''),
                'refund_business_date': str(refund.ydental_refund_business_date or ''),
                'refund_channel': refund.ydental_refund_channel or '',
                'native_payment': refund.ydental_native_payment_id.name or '',
                'reason': refund.ydental_reason})
            target = refund
        else:
            raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: Unknown settlement report kind.'))
        return target, payload

settlement._validate_pdf_scope.source:
def _validate_pdf_scope(self):
        scope = self.env.context.get('ydental_settlement_pdf_scope')
        session = self.env['ydental.access.service']._scope()
        if type(scope) is not SettlementPdfScope or (
                scope.actor_id, scope.session_id, scope.revision) != (
                    self.env.uid, session.id, session.ydental_revision):
            raise AccessError(self.env._('access_denied: A bound settlement export request is required.'))
        _target, payload = self._report_payload(scope.kind, scope.source_id)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        if digest != scope.digest:
            raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: Settlement report source changed while rendering.'))
        return payload

supply._lock.source:
def _lock(self):
        # Same space lock as S02. The UPDATE is essential under PostgreSQL
        # repeatable read: a stale snapshot must serialize/retry, not sell twice.
        self.env.cr.execute('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(%s)', [26002])
        mutex = self.env.ref('ydental_supply.ydental_supply_mutex', raise_if_not_found=False)
        if not mutex and self.env.context.get('install_mode'):
            return
        if not mutex:
            raise UserError(self.env._('Supply serialization configuration is missing.'))
        self.env.cr.execute('UPDATE ydental_supply_mutex SET ydental_revision=ydental_revision+1 WHERE id=%s', [mutex.id])
        self.env.invalidate_all()

treatment._dispense.source:
def _dispense(self, execution_id, lease_id, lease_token, order_id, order_version, line_id,
                  lot_id, quantity, source, reason, policy, already_performed=False):
        if policy != 'demo_confirmation':
            raise UserError(self.env._('policy_unpublished: Production price policy awaits approval.'))
        execution, order, segment = self._pharmacy(execution_id, lease_id, lease_token, order_id, order_version)
        line = self._get('line', line_id, 'pharmacy')
        if line.ydental_order_id != order or line.state != 'issued':
            raise AccessError(self.env._('source_required: Select an issued line of the called prescription.'))
        self._quantity(quantity, line.ydental_uom_id)
        prior = self._model('event').search([('ydental_store_id', '=', order.ydental_store_id.id), ('ydental_source', '=', source)], limit=1)
        remaining = self._remaining(line) + (prior.ydental_quantity if prior and prior.ydental_order_line_id == line else 0)
        if line.ydental_uom_id.compare(quantity, remaining) > 0:
            raise UserError(self.env._('overdispense: The actual issue would exceed the remaining approved quantity.'))
        lot = self.env['ydental.inventory.service']._lot(lot_id, order.ydental_store_id)
        if lot.product_id != line.ydental_product_id:
            raise ValidationError(self.env._('source_category_mismatch: The batch must contain the exact prescribed medicine.'))
        self._validate_prescription(line)
        link = self._medicine_link(order.ydental_store_id, product=line.ydental_product_id, required=not already_performed)
        result = self._event(execution, link.ydental_catalog_id if link else line.ydental_mapping_id.ydental_catalog_id, quantity, source, reason,
            [{'lot_id': lot.id, 'quantity': quantity, 'uom_id': line.ydental_uom_id.id, 'kind': 'prescription'}], kind='prescription', line=line, already_performed=already_performed, medicine_link=link, expected_product=line.ydental_product_id)
        self._audit('actual_dispense', order, dict(result, line_id=line.id, remaining=self._remaining(line)))
        return dict(result, line_id=line.id, remaining=self._remaining(line))

treatment._operate.source:
def _operate(self, operation, payload, key):
        handlers = {'execute': self._execute, 'order': self._draft_order, 'edit_order': self._edit_order,
            'issue': self._issue, 'cancel_exam': self._cancel_exam, 'dispense': self._dispense,
            'finish': self._finish, 'reconcile': self._reconcile, 'review_price': self._review_price,
            'publish_medicine': self._publish_medicine, 'verify_medicine': self._verify_medicine,
            'correct': self._correct, 'return_material': self._return_material, 'refer': self._refer}
        if operation not in handlers or not isinstance(payload, dict) or not isinstance(key, str) or not 1 <= len(key) <= 120:
            raise ValidationError(self.env._('invalid_action: Supply a documented action and stable request key.'))
        try:
            inspect.signature(handlers[operation]).bind(**payload)
        except TypeError as error:
            raise ValidationError(self.env._('invalid_action: Unknown or missing execution arguments.')) from error
        category = 'pharmacy' if operation in ('dispense', 'finish') else 'price' if operation in ('review_price', 'publish_medicine') else 'medical'
        if operation in ('reconcile', 'return_material', 'verify_medicine'):
            event = self._model('event').browse(self.env['ydental.intake.service']._id(payload.get('event_id'))).exists()
            if event and event.ydental_kind == 'prescription':
                category = 'pharmacy'
        store = self._access(category)
        queue = self.env['ydental.queue.service']
        queue._connection()
        digest = fingerprint([operation, store.id, payload])
        with self.env.cr.savepoint():
            # S01 user/session -> S04 patient -> S03 supply -> S05 intake ->
            # S06 queue -> S07 inventory. All B paths acquire this before native
            # stock or B sources; source adapters never acquire upstream fences.
            queue._locks()
            self.env['ydental.inventory.service']._lock()
            self.env.cr.execute('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(%s)', [32008])
            self._access(category)
            queue._connection()
            prior = self._model('receipt').search([('ydental_actor_id', '=', self.env.uid), ('ydental_key', '=', key)], limit=1)
            if prior:
                if prior.ydental_fingerprint != digest:
                    raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: This key belongs to another action.'))
                return dict(prior.ydental_result, result='already_accepted')
            result = handlers[operation](**payload)
            self._model('receipt')._new({'name': operation, 'ydental_store_id': store.id, 'ydental_category': category,
                'ydental_actor_id': self.env.uid, 'ydental_key': key, 'ydental_fingerprint': digest, 'ydental_result': result})
            return dict(result, result='accepted')

treatment._pharmacy.source:
def _pharmacy(self, execution_id, lease_id, lease_token, order_id, order_version):
        execution = self._serving(execution_id, lease_id, lease_token, 'pharmacy')
        order = self._get('order', order_id, 'pharmacy')
        segment = self._model('segment').search([('ydental_task_id', '=', execution.ydental_task_id.id),
            ('ydental_order_id', '=', order.id), ('state', 'in', ('pending', 'active'))], limit=1)
        if not segment or order.state != 'issued' or order.ydental_version != order_version or order.ydental_patient_id != execution.ydental_patient_id:
            raise UserError(self.env._('order_frozen: Select the issued prescription version bound to this actual pharmacy segment.'))
        if segment.ydental_execution_id and segment.ydental_execution_id != execution:
            raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: This prescription segment is bound to another execution.'))
        segment._save({'state': 'active', 'ydental_execution_id': execution.id})
        return execution, order, segment

treatment._quote.source:
def _quote(self, event):
        intake = self.env['ydental.intake.service']
        # Freeze at the actual event time. A future replacement is never used
        # to silently reconstruct an unknown historical price.
        version, values = intake._quote(event.ydental_store_id, event.ydental_catalog_id.id,
            event.ydental_store_id.company_id.currency_id.id, abs(event.ydental_quantity), instant=event.ydental_actual_at)
        snapshot = intake._new('snapshot', event.ydental_store_id, dict(values, name=event.ydental_source,
            ydental_source='s08b-event-' + str(event.id), ydental_policy='demo_confirmation', ydental_actor_id=self.env.uid))
        event._save({'ydental_price_snapshot_id': snapshot.id})

treatment._return_material.source:
def _return_material(self, event_id, inventory_event_id, quantity, uom_id, source, reason):
        event = self._model('event').browse(self.env['ydental.intake.service']._id(event_id)).exists()
        category = 'pharmacy' if event and event.ydental_kind == 'prescription' else 'medical'
        event = self._get('event', event_id, category)
        row = self._model('consumption').search([('ydental_event_id', '=', event.id),
            ('ydental_inventory_event_id', '=', inventory_event_id)], limit=1)
        if not row or row.ydental_inventory_event_id.state != 'done':
            raise AccessError(self.env._('source_required: Select a completed physical issue from this clinical event.'))
        result = self.env['ydental.inventory.service']._return(event.ydental_store_id, inventory_event_id,
            quantity, uom_id, source, reason)
        self._audit('physical_return_quarantine', event, result, reason)
        return result

treatment._serving.source:
def _serving(self, execution_id, lease_id, lease_token, category):
        queue = self.env['ydental.queue.service']
        lease = queue._held(lease_id, lease_token)
        execution = queue._source_execution(execution_id, lease)
        if execution.state != 'serving' or lease.ydental_category != category or lease.ydental_expires_at <= queue._now():
            raise AccessError(self.env._('execution_required: The current holder must start the actual service.'))
        store = self._access(category)
        if execution.ydental_store_id != store or execution.ydental_service_snapshot != queue._service_snapshot(execution.ydental_task_id):
            raise UserError(self.env._('version_conflict: The actual service source changed.'))
        failure = queue._service_eligibility(queue._execution_entry(execution), lease.ydental_station_id)
        if failure:
            raise AccessError(failure)
        self.env['ydental.patient.service']._current_relation(execution.ydental_patient_id, store)
        return execution

treatment._settle.source:
def _settle(self, event):
        if event.ydental_pending_reason == 'medicine_evidence_missing':
            return
        price = self._price_values(event)
        if not price:
            event._save({'ydental_pending_reason': 'missing_price'})
            return
        pending = []
        rows = self._model('consumption').search([('ydental_event_id', '=', event.id)])
        inventory = self.env['ydental.inventory.service']
        if event.ydental_kind in ('chairside', 'prescription') or event.ydental_medicine_link_id:
            self._check_medication(event.ydental_medicine_link_id, [
                {'lot_id': r.ydental_lot_id.id, 'quantity': r.ydental_quantity, 'uom_id': r.ydental_uom_id.id, 'kind': r.ydental_kind}
                for r in rows], event.ydental_quantity, event.ydental_product_id, correction=bool(event.ydental_parent_id))
        # If a real historical project is short in any batch, persist its S07
        # pending fact first and defer every other issue. No partial native
        # consumption is posted merely because another material was available.
        unavailable = rows.filtered(lambda row: row.ydental_inventory_event_id and row.ydental_inventory_event_id.state != 'done')
        for row in rows.filtered(lambda row: not row.ydental_inventory_event_id):
            lot = row.ydental_lot_id
            config = inventory._config(event.ydental_store_id)
            stock_quantity, unit, unit_snapshot = inventory._unit(lot.product_id, row.ydental_quantity, row.ydental_uom_id.id)
            batch = inventory._batch(lot, event.ydental_store_id)
            unusable = not batch.ydental_enabled or not lot.product_id.active or not lot.expiration_date or lot.expiration_date <= fields.Datetime.now()
            short = lot.product_id.uom_id.compare(inventory._quantity(lot, inventory._location(config, lot.product_id)), stock_quantity) < 0
            if unusable or short:
                unavailable |= row
        if unavailable:
            for row in unavailable.filtered(lambda row: not row.ydental_inventory_event_id):
                result = inventory._source_action(InventorySource(self.env.uid, event.ydental_store_id.id, row.id))
                row._save({'ydental_inventory_event_id': result['id']})
            event._save({'ydental_pending_reason': 'inventory_pending'})
            return
        for row in rows:
            if not row.ydental_inventory_event_id:
                result = self.env['ydental.inventory.service']._source_action(InventorySource(self.env.uid, event.ydental_store_id.id, row.id))
                row._save({'ydental_inventory_event_id': result['id']})
            if row.ydental_inventory_event_id.state != 'done':
                pending.append(row.id)
        if pending:
            event._save({'ydental_pending_reason': 'inventory_pending'})
            return
        if not self._model('fee').search_count([('ydental_event_id', '=', event.id)]):
            currency = self.env['res.currency'].browse(price['currency'])
            parent_fee = self._model('fee').search([('ydental_event_id', '=', event.ydental_parent_id.id)], limit=1) if event.ydental_parent_id else False
            self._new('fee', event, {'name': event.name, 'ydental_event_id': event.id,
                'ydental_parent_id': parent_fee.id if parent_fee else False,
                'ydental_medicine_link_id': event.ydental_medicine_link_id.id, 'ydental_product_id': event.ydental_product_id.id,
                'ydental_price_snapshot_id': event.ydental_price_snapshot_id.id,
                'ydental_price_review_id': event.ydental_price_review_id.id,
                'ydental_quantity': event.ydental_quantity, 'ydental_unit_price': price['unit_price'],
                'ydental_currency_id': currency.id, 'ydental_amount': currency.round(event.ydental_quantity * price['unit_price']),
                'ydental_policy': 'demo_confirmation'})
        event._save({'state': 'confirmed', 'ydental_pending_reason': False})
